# ItemSwitch

Switches an item between appearance states (for example a cloak, a mantle, or both together) with verbs, using it
in hand, or activating it in the world. The state changes the item's sprite, in-hand prefix and, through the
clothing system, the equipped prefix.

Ported from GoobStation's _Shitmed item-switch system. Battery-powered states are supported but no Wolfgate item
uses them yet.
